name: Mossy Hollow
description: A warm, walkable hidden forest town arranged around giant cedar trunks, a creek, and a circular gathering green.

visual.lighting: Soft broken sunlight by day; warm lantern pools at dusk; never ominous.
visual.scale_notes: Paths and rails accommodate adult Sasquatches; small woodland neighbors use lower rails and narrow side paths.

layout_rules: The gathering green sits east of the creek and west of Moonberry Market's awning row.
The root bridge is the main route toward Canopy Creek School.
Big Cedar Home is a short uphill walk north of the green.
continuity_locks: Cozy old-growth valley, never an urban street or medieval village.
Buildings and props use tactile, repairable materials.
Background characters follow the global barefoot rule.
